insurer: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Ltd

room_rent.note: Policy covers room rent up to Sum Insured with no stated per-day cap or room-type restriction in the product benefit table

icu.note: ICU charges covered under Inpatient Care up to Sum Insured; no separate sub-limit stated

copayment.display: None (standard); 20% for international critical illness treatment
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on domestic claims. 20% co-pay applies specifically to International Treatment for 11 specified Critical Illnesses (Section 3.17 / Elite Plan). Risk-based co-pay up to 30% may be applied at underwriting for specific conditions.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; maternity sub-limits by plan
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI. Maternity: ₹2L–₹6.25L depending on SI. Ambulance: ₹3,000–₹10,000. Animal bite vaccination: ₹2,500–₹7,500. Emergency domestic evacuation: ₹3L (Elite). Worldwide emergency: 50% of SI up to ₹20L. No sub-limits on standard inpatient diseases.

deductible.note: Base plan has no deductible. Optional top-up on annual aggregate basis with deductible of ₹1/2/3/4/5/10L available. Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization has USD 1,000 deductible per hospitalisation.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Classic and Supreme plans: 36 months. Elite plan: 24 months. Best achievable inbuilt value is 24 months on Elite plan.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 16 listed conditions (cataract, hernia, stones, knee/hip replacement, etc.) have 24-month waiting period across all plans

maternity.note: Inbuilt only on Elite plan; sub-limit ₹2L–₹6.25L depending on SI; max 2 deliveries lifetime; both spouses must be on same floater; 36-month waiting period

cumulative_bonus.note: Classic: 10% per claim-free year up to 50%. Supreme & Elite: 20% per claim-free year up to 100%. Bonus not reduced for future claims once earned.

restoration.note: Re-load of 100% of Base SI once per policy year. Not available for same illness/same insured person (unrelated illness or different insured member for same illness). Not available for worldwide emergency or international critical illness benefits. Optional Supreme Plus/Elite Plus add-on includes 'Refresh' for same illness same person (once in policy lifetime).

pre_hosp.note: Classic: 30 days pre-hospitalisation. Supreme: 60 days. Elite: 60 days. Best inbuilt value is 60 days.

post_hosp.note: Classic: 60 days. Supreme: 90 days. Elite: 180 days. Best inbuilt value is 180 days.

day_care.note: All day-care procedures covered up to Sum Insured across all plans

domiciliary.note: Covered if treatment continues for uninterrupted 3+ days and hospitalisation would otherwise be required. Pre-hosp expenses payable; post-hosp not payable under domiciliary claims.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year across all plans

organ_donor.note: Inpatient harvesting expenses for organ donor covered within recipient's Sum Insured. Pre/post-hosp and screening expenses of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Per hospitalisation limit. Supreme Plus and Elite Plus add app-based cab facility as additional ambulance cover.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured per policy period

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) are explicitly listed as non-payable in Annexure I (List I). No rider available to cover them.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt on Elite (excl. US/Canada); optional to add US/Canada
global_cover.note: Elite plan includes Worldwide Emergency Hospitalisation (50% of SI up to ₹20L, USD 1,000 deductible) and International Treatment for 11 Critical Illnesses (up to SI, 20% co-pay), both excluding US & Canada. Option to include US & Canada by paying additional premium at inception.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months) no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy. Not applicable for policies with tenure less than one year or on renewals.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Hereditary conditions (Crohn's, Haemophilia, etc.), sleep disorders, sexual problems, STDs, alopecia, ADHD, circumcision, external congenital anomaly, ancillary hospital charges

optional_riders.display: Top-up (aggregate deductible), Hospital Cash, US/Canada global cover, Supreme Plus (Refresh SI, Bariatric, Mobility Devices, PED life-threat cover), Elite Plus (IVF, 3 extra CI for intl. treatment)
